fullContent:
Chukkumthippalyadi Gulika (Vati) 
 Reference: Sahasrayogam, Vati prakarana, 2. 
 Chukkumthippalyadi Gulika (Vati) is an Ayurvedic medicine meant to treat the fever. It is available in tablet form. Use of this medicine is quite effective to treat the chronic fever, malarial fever, fever, cough and flu. It balances the Vata and Kapha in body. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Chukkum – ginger – Zingiber officinalis 
 Tippali – Long pepper – Piper longum 
 Ghritkumari – Aloe vera 
 Vacha – Acorus calamus 
 Kombu – Mrigashringa 
 Jiraka – Cuminum cyminum 
 Rudraksha – Elaeocarpus sphaericus 
 Kiriyattu – Chiraita – Andrographis paniculata 
 Chanchaliyavu – Gandabiroja 
 Purified copper sulphate-CuSo4 
 Camphor – Cinnamomum capmhora 
 Manhova – Manashila – Purified Realgar 
 Gandhamarjara Veerya – caveat cat semen 
 Milk 
 Indravalli – Cardiospermum halicacabum 
 
 Dosage 
 Take 1 – 2 tablets once or two times in a day after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. It is administered along with honey or water. 
 Indications 
 
 Chronic fever 
 Malarial fever 
 Cold 
 Cough 
 Flu 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 Take this medicine strictly only under medical supervision. 
 This medicine should be avoided for children and pregnant ladies or better to take this medicine under strict medical supervision. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
